explication: 影視TV is an Android TV/mobile media player for browsing user-configured sources, watching on-demand video and live channels, and playing local files or URLs. The main user journey is browse or search, select content, resolve it into playback media, then play it through a selectable engine; playback also supports subtitles, danmaku, and related controls. Separate documented capabilities include DLNA casting/receiving and cross-device features. The graph combines README-described capabilities with the sampled playback/runtime code; unsampled UI and integration wiring is shown only where documented, not as inspected call flow.
